articles.title: Ametek Near Deal for Part of CD&R-Owned Industrials Company
articles.mainIdea: Ametek Near Deal for Part of CD&R-Owned Industrials Company
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Ametek Near Deal for Part of CD&R-Owned Industrials Company. Ametek is in exclusive talks to acquire part of an industrials company owned by private-equity firm Clayton, Dubilier & Rice, according to people familiar with the matter. The business was formed in 2022 as a holding company for the industrial assets of Roper Technologies Roper later sold a majority stake in Indicor to CD&R. It would be a relatively small bite for Ametek, which has a market value of more than $52 billion. Related tickers mentioned: AME.
